arguments.command:
python 2>/dev/null << 'EOF'
import parse

# Check search regex patterns with surrounding text
formats = [
    "a {} c",           # default
    "a {:<} c",         # left-aligned  
    "a {:^} c",         # center-aligned
]

for fmt in formats:
    p = parse.compile(fmt)
    print(f"{fmt!r}:")
    print(f"  _expression={p._expression!r}")
    print(f"  _search_re.pattern={p._search_re.pattern!r}")
    
    # Test search behavior
    tests = [
        " a b c ",
        " a hello world c ",
        "   hello   world   c   ",
    ]
    for text in tests:
        result = p.search(text)
        if result:
            print(f"  search({text!r}) -> {result.fixed}")
        else:
            print(f"  search({text!r}) -> None")
    print()
EOF
